correctness.rationale: The prime-to-23 isogeny to five elliptic Legendre quotients preserves p-rank, a-number and Newton slopes. The exact degree-eleven Hasse polynomial has nine F23 roots and an irreducible quadratic; all eleven lie in F529. The five cross-ratios, S5 transitivity on divisor pairs and exact root-pair census reduce every geometric multiplicity ≥2 to 110 ordered root pairs. An independently implemented F529 polynomial/root enumeration recovered s=2:56, s=3:18, s=4:36; the combinatorial identity C(s,2)N_s=10 A_s yields N2=560,N3=N4=60 and the rational parity split. Local forgetful coordinates give transverse pair intersections, with higher intersections having distinct tangents. Finite enumeration is exhaustive only because every multiple intersection can be relabelled to two supersingular Legendre parameters and all Hasse roots are in F529; it is not used to extrapolate directly to all extensions.

final_claim: For smooth ordered five-branch Humbert curves in characteristic 23, no parameter has five supersingular elliptic factors. Exactly 60 marked parameters have four factors supersingular, making one S5 orbit. The complete strata have 560 geometric double, 60 triple and 60 quadruple intersection points, with N_s(23^m) formulas alternating with parity.
